name: Ayusawa Mio
source:
Married for 5 years.

She teases Koutarou.

When she was caught shoplifting and asked why she is doing it, she says that it is because her husband is a drunk and has no income. This is complete lie. When asked why she lies, she answers, because of my parents I developed a habit of lying without realizing it (this is also a lie).

In fact, she is a married woman who married into the family of a Noh performer, and she is acting like this because of the stress of not being on the same page with her mother-in-law.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=540985&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
